description: This file defines a React functional component named Tools that provides a user interface for adjusting preference settings related to note saving status indicators in a web application. It manages local state and interacts with application preferences through props.

classes.name: Tools
classes.description: A React functional component that renders preference controls for toggling note saving status indicator visibility.

methods.name: toggleSavingIndicatorUpdates
methods.description: Toggles the updateSavingIndicator state and updates the application preference accordingly.
